about_the_game:
Soviet Survival is an isometric, open-world survival game where you must find your place in the ruined Soviet Union.

Can you survive in this merciless new reality?

🔴 Survive at all costs

Hunt or take risks in the ruins of the old world, getting rare supplies. The choice is yours: hide and build or take risks in search of a better life.

🔴 Cooperative mode

Play alone or with friends. Together, survivors are stronger, but you can't trust everyone...

🔴 Leveling and loot system

Customize your character with skills and Soviet equipment. From a sawed-off shotgun to an AK-47 - choose a weapon and survival style.

🔴 Crafting and construction

Create everything from homemade weapons to fortified shelters. Strengthen your positions and defend yourself from threats, be it hungry beasts, mutants or marauders.

🔴 Realistic fight for life

Hunger, thirst and radioactive zones – even without mutants and bandits, this world will try to kill you.

🔴 Changing world

Dynamic weather, day and night cycle, as well as events that make each playthrough unique.

How long can you hold out in a world where hope is a scarce commodity?

Soviet Survival is your story in a harsh alternative reality. Are you ready to fight?

content_descriptors.notes: The game contains scenes with blood, murders, images of corpses. The game may also contain themes related to survival in extreme conditions, including hunger, despair. Alcohol consumption.
